text.text: I'm a UX researcher and product strategist who turns complex needs into clear, thoughtful product direction. My work spans research, strategy, prototyping, and implementation, with a focus on creating products that genuinely reflect how people think, behave, and make decisions.

My background in public health shapes the way I approach product work. It taught me to look beyond individual pain points, understand the systems around them, and use qualitative and quantitative insights to make informed decisions. I now bring that same human-centered, systems-minded approach to products across health, hospitality, travel, social impact, and emerging technology.
I'm always open to thoughtful conversations about UX research, product strategy, and building products that people love.
2020 - 2022 · Columbia University · Master of Public Health (MPH)
I'm currently exploring opportunities in UX research, product strategy, journey design, and early-stage product work. Based in California and open to relocation.
